name: Coffee @ Work
address: 65 Marsh St, Mossel Bay, 6500, South Africa
description_short: Family-run coffee shop on Marsh Street serving specialty roasts, homemade treats, and fresh daily lunches.
description_long:
Tucked along Marsh Street in central Mossel Bay, Coffee @ Work has built a loyal following with its carefully selected coffee beans and genuinely warm service. The family-run café roasts its own beans and serves everything from classic cappuccinos to pour-overs, alongside a cabinet filled with homemade cakes, muffins, and savoury treats baked fresh each morning.

The daily lunch menu changes with what's available, but you can count on hearty sandwiches, quiches, and seasonal salads. It's the kind of place where locals pop in for their morning flat white and end up staying for a slice of carrot cake. The atmosphere is relaxed and unpretentious, with wooden tables and enough seating to accommodate the steady flow of regulars and visitors discovering Mossel Bay's coffee scene.

Whether you need a quick takeaway before heading to the beach or a proper sit-down breakfast, Coffee @ Work delivers honest café food without fuss. The location makes it an easy stop between exploring the town's historical sites and the harbour.
